name: Tome of the Cabal
summary: In the Barrens, Strahad Farsan sends Horde warlocks east in search of a lost grimoire. The Tome of the Cabal holds rites for summoning and binding a felhunter, and the search begins with cartographer Jorah Annison in the Undercity.

sections.title: A Hunt for Ancient Knowledge
sections.body: Strahad Farsan says a felhunter takes more than ordinary fel magic to summon. These predators feed on magical energies and resist standard summoning circles. An initiate needs specialized circles and an ancient grimoire called the Tome of the Cabal. The first order of warlocks to bind a felhunter without outside aid wrote the book. Its rites and seals show how to enslave such a dangerous demon.

sections.title: The Cartographer of Undercity
sections.body: Copies of the Tome of the Cabal have long been lost to warlocks in Kalimdor, so Strahad sends his student across the sea to Jorah Annison in the Undercity. Annison works as a royal cartographer, mapping Lordaeron, but knows a great deal about ancient and obscure texts. He admits that he despises mapmaking and hungers for rare histories, occult narratives, and treatises on dark magic.

faq.q: What is the Tome of the Cabal?
faq.answer: The Tome of the Cabal is a rare occult grimoire written by the first warlocks to summon and bind a felhunter without outside help. Its precise instructions, wards, and rites allow one of these magic-devouring beasts to be brought safely into Azeroth.

faq.q: Why does Strahad Farsan send you to the Undercity?
faq.answer: Strahad and his acolytes in the Barrens have no copy of the Tome of the Cabal. He sends you to Jorah Annison, an Undercity cartographer and scholar of rare, ancient books who may know where to recover the Tome.
Jorah Annison is a Forsaken scholar who works in the Undercity. His official trade is cartography, but his passion lies in obscure texts, necromantic treatises, and ancient literature.

faq.q: Why is a special book needed to summon a felhunter?
aliases: why is felhunter hard to summon
faq.answer: Felhunters feed on arcane and other magical energies, making them dangerous to summon through ordinary demonic circles. The Tome of the Cabal details safeguards that bind them before they consume the summoner.

angles.text: As a Horde warlock, you must complete this rite of passage to tame a felhunter. It takes you between Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms to gather forgotten ritual components.
As a member of the Horde, you see Kalimdor's dark casters work with Forsaken occult scholars beneath the ruins of Lordaeron.
